brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished a vehicle repair garage in the Shuweika suburb north of Tulkarm, the Ma'an news agency reported. The structure, which operated as a commercial workshop for vehicle maintenance and repairs, was razed during a military operation in the densely populated residential area.

The demolition is one of numerous property destructions carried out by Israeli forces across the West Bank. Shuweika, a built-up district adjoining Tulkarm city, has experienced repeated military incursions over recent years, with Palestinian-owned buildings regularly targeted for demolition under Israeli military orders. The garage's destruction adds to the ongoing pattern of infrastructure loss affecting Palestinian communities in the occupied territory.
title: Israeli forces demolish vehicle repair garage in northern West Bank
